intro: The Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie from the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts) offers a delicious sweet finish to your Mediterranean meal. At just 140 calories, this buttery treat features rich chocolate chips baked into a golden blondie base. Made with quality ingredients including wheat flour, butter, and sugar, it delivers classic dessert satisfaction without overwhelming your meal.
priceCalories: Priced between $2.75 and $2.95, the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie contains 140 calories per serving. With 2g of protein, 22g of carbohydrates, and 5g of fat, it provides a balanced sweet treat. This makes it one of the lighter options on the [full CAVA menu](/), perfect for those watching their calorie intake while still wanting dessert.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie apart is its partnership with Greyston Bakery, a social enterprise that practices open hiring. Each blondie combines buttery richness with sweet chocolate chips in a perfectly portioned serving. The texture strikes an ideal balance between chewy and soft, making it a standout choice among [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts) selections.
nutritionFacts: Each Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie delivers 140 calories with a macronutrient profile of 2g protein, 22g carbohydrates, and 5g fat. The ingredient list includes wheat flour, butter, sugar, and chocolate chips. For detailed nutritional information across all menu items, visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track your complete meal.
whatsInside: The Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie features simple, quality ingredients: wheat flour forms the base, real butter adds richness, sugar provides sweetness, and chocolate chips deliver indulgent flavor. This straightforward ingredient list ensures authentic taste without unnecessary additives. The combination creates a classic American dessert with Mediterranean meal compatibility.
tasteLike: The Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie tastes like a classic homemade treat with buttery, vanilla-forward notes and pockets of melted chocolate throughout. The texture is soft and chewy with slightly crisp edges. The sweetness level is perfectly balanced, not overpowering, making it an ideal complement after enjoying savory dishes from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains).
customize: The Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie comes as a ready-to-enjoy dessert without customization options. However, you can enhance your experience by pairing it with beverages from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). Consider ordering it alongside coffee or tea for a classic dessert pairing, or enjoy it as a standalone sweet treat.
pairsWell: This blondie pairs excellently with any bowl or pita from CAVA. It complements the savory flavors of options from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) and [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas). The sweet chocolate and buttery notes provide perfect contrast to Mediterranean spices and herbs, creating a satisfying meal conclusion.
healthyChoice: At 140 calories and 5g of fat, the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie is a moderate dessert choice. While it contains 22g of carbohydrates primarily from sugar, its portion-controlled size allows for mindful indulgence. For those with dietary restrictions, check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) as it contains wheat, dairy, and eggs.
howToOrder: To order the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie, simply add it to your meal when building your bowl or pita at any [CAVA Locations](/locations). You can order in-store, through the CAVA app, or via online ordering. Request it at checkout as your dessert selection for $2.75 to $2.95 depending on location.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Greyston Chocolate Fudge Brownie at 150 calories, the Chocolate Chip Blondie offers a lighter option with similar pricing. The Whisked! cookies contain significantly more calories at 220-260 per serving and cost $3.25-$3.55. The blondie provides the best calorie-to-satisfaction ratio among desserts on the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts).
whoShouldTry: The Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie appeals to anyone seeking a satisfying dessert without excessive calories. It is perfect for chocolate lovers, families sharing meals, and those supporting social enterprise businesses. However, individuals following gluten-free diets should explore options on the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) instead, as this contains wheat flour.
worthTrying: The Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie is absolutely worth trying for its combination of quality, value, and social impact. At under 150 calories and less than $3, it delivers authentic dessert satisfaction while supporting Greyston Bakery's mission. The classic flavor profile and perfect portion size make it an ideal finish to any CAVA meal experience.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie?
faqs.a: The Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie contains 140 calories per serving, making it one of the lighter dessert options at CAVA. It also provides 2g protein, 22g carbohydrates, and 5g fat.

faqs.q: What is the price of the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie?
faqs.a: The Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie is priced between $2.75 and $2.95 depending on your location. This makes it an affordable dessert option to complete your CAVA meal.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie?
faqs.a: The blondie contains wheat flour, butter, sugar, and chocolate chips. These simple, quality ingredients create the classic buttery flavor and soft, chewy texture that makes this dessert so satisfying.

faqs.q: Is the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie gluten-free?
faqs.a: No, the Greyston Chocolate Chip Blondie is not gluten-free as it contains wheat flour. Guests with gluten sensitivities should check the CAVA Allergen Menu for suitable dessert alternatives.

faqs.q: How does the Chocolate Chip Blondie compare to other CAVA desserts?
faqs.a: At 140 calories, the Chocolate Chip Blondie is lighter than the Chocolate Fudge Brownie (150 cal) and significantly lower than the Whisked! cookies (220-260 cal), while offering similar pricing and great taste.
